method: Exact current service SQL/parameter order, explicit PostgreSQL inferred parameter types, forced custom and generic prepared read-only plans after workload; EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS SETTINGS. Forced plans diagnose possibilities; they do not identify which per-connection plan was chosen during load.

plans.name: ready
plans.sql:
SELECT to_jsonb(n)-'search_document' FROM nodes n WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND kind='task' AND task_state='active' AND NOT deleted AND NOT retired AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR id>$2)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges pc JOIN nodes child ON child.id=pc.target AND child.workspace_id=pc.workspace_id WHERE pc.workspace_id=n.workspace_id AND pc.source=n.id AND pc.edge_type='parent-child' AND NOT pc.deleted AND NOT child.deleted)
AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM edges pe JOIN nodes parent ON parent.id=pe.source AND parent.workspace_id=pe.workspace_id
 LEFT JOIN edges ge ON ge.workspace_id=pe.workspace_id AND ge.target=parent.id AND ge.edge_type='parent-child' AND NOT ge.deleted
 LEFT JOIN nodes grandparent ON grandparent.id=ge.source AND grandparent.workspace_id=ge.workspace_id
 WHERE pe.workspace_id=n.workspace_id AND pe.target=n.id AND pe.edge_type='parent-child' AND NOT pe.deleted
 AND (parent.deleted OR parent.retired OR parent.task_state='draft' OR grandparent.deleted OR grandparent.retired OR grandparent.task_state='draft'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e JOIN nodes prerequisite ON prerequisite.id=e.source WHERE e.workspace_id=n.workspace_id AND e.target=n.id AND e.edge_type='blocks' AND NOT e.deleted AND (prerequisite.deleted OR prerequisite.task_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed')) ORDER BY id LIMIT $3

Plans.Filter: ((NOT deleted) AND (NOT retired) AND (workspace_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid) AND (kind = 'task'::text) AND (task_state = 'active'::text))
(parent.deleted OR parent.retired OR (parent.task_state = 'draft'::text) OR grandparent.deleted OR grandparent.retired OR (grandparent.task_state = 'draft'::text))

plans.name: search_common
plans.sql:
WITH matching AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT id FROM nodes
                 WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND NOT deleted
                   AND ($2::text IS NULL OR kind=$2)
                   AND ($3 OR NOT retired)
                   AND ($4 OR verification IS DISTINCT FROM 'disputed')
                   AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR ((valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= $5) AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > $5)))
                   AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR (review_at IS NOT NULL AND review_at <= $6))
                   AND search_document @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english',$7)
                   AND ($8::uuid IS NULL OR id>$8)
             ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM matching ORDER BY id LIMIT $9)
             SELECT to_jsonb(n)-'search_document' FROM selected
               JOIN nodes n ON n.id=selected.id AND n.workspace_id=$1 ORDER BY selected.id

Plans.Filter: ((NOT deleted) AND (NOT retired) AND (verification IS DISTINCT FROM 'disputed'::text) AND (search_document @@ '''authent'''::tsquery) AND (workspace_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid))
